$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006): this hand-written schema is the shape of an apply request of Floorspec Ops 0.2. A request it rejects is malformed, FS-OPS-001 (1.1.2). As for Core documents, a validator maps every number written with a fraction or an exponent to a non-number before applying it, so that 2.0 is not a length.
title: Floorspec Ops 0.2 apply request
description: 1.1: { "batch": [ … ], "context": { "locks": [ … ], "retired": [ … ] } }. The batch is at least one operation, applied in order as one transaction; context is optional.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: 1.1: a JSON array of at least one operation.

context.title: Context
context.description: 1.1: what is in force for this request — the locks (chapter 6) and the IDs retired from the document's history (1.5).

retired.description: IDs that once existed in the document and are never minted or named again (1.5).

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: 6.1: exactly one of the three kinds.

oneOf.title: Element lock
oneOf.description: The element keeps exactly its content in A, in the same collection; a wall's or separator's junctions, the junctions of a room's face's outer cycle, and the junctions of the wall an extension element is on, stay where they are.

oneOf.title: Length lock
oneOf.description: The wall's location line keeps its length.

oneOf.title: Distance lock
oneOf.description: The two walls stay parallel, at the distance they are in A.
